name: Enactus at UVA
tagline: Put business skills to work for the community.
description: Enactus at UVA connects hands-on consulting with social entrepreneurship. Affiliated with McIntire, the organization provides pro-bono support to socially responsible businesses in Charlottesville.

sections.body: Work on practical business challenges while supporting local organizations.

sections.title: Grow through experience
sections.body: Build consulting skills through hands-on work, workshops and a collaborative student community.

name: Portico Impact Fund
description: Portico Impact Fund combines experiential finance education with socially responsible equity investing. Its approach connects investment research, member development and charitable giving.

sections.title: Investing with purpose
sections.body: Explore how business performance and environmental, social and governance considerations inform equity research.

cards.title: Investment research
cards.description: Study companies across sector-focused coverage groups.

cards.title: Experiential education
cards.description: Develop finance knowledge through applied investment work.

sections.title: Returns that reach further
sections.body: Portico describes donating a portion of annual returns to local charitable causes.

sections.title: Build your perspective
sections.body: The fund welcomes different academic backgrounds to learn about investing and responsible business.

name: Common Cents at UVA
tagline: Make personal finance easier to understand.
description: Common Cents at UVA promotes financial literacy for students and the Charlottesville community. Its broader mission is to make personal finance approachable and help people make informed money decisions.

sections.title: Practical financial literacy
sections.body: Explore the everyday decisions that shape financial wellbeing.

cards.description: Understand spending, saving and planning for financial goals.

cards.description: Learn the fundamentals of responsible credit use.

cards.title: Investing
cards.description: Build familiarity with long-term investing and risk.

sections.title: Knowledge for everyday life
